474:t_012:1.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「This is bad! At this rate, it'll cause a huge explosion and take the surrounding area with it!」

474:t_013:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「A $$ゲッターロボ$$... OTHER THAN MINE...!」

474:t_013:2.en:
$$隼人$$
「Don't make me laugh, $$竜馬$$. You've sunk to the level of an $$インベーダー#robot$$. We aren't going to fall behind you.」

474:t_015:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「$$竜馬$$! We'll be the ones to finish you off!」

474:t_018:0.en:
$$隼人$$
「$$竜馬$$... I'll deliver the final blow.」

474:t_018:2.en:
???
「What a beautiful friendship, $$スティンガー$$.」

474:t_019:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「It's $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$!」

474:t_019:3.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「It has been a while, gentlemen.」

474:t_019:4.en:
$$カイエン$$
「What the hell are they?!」

474:t_019:5.en:
$$さやか$$
「$$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$... They were originally $$ゲッター$$ Ray researchers, like Dr. $$早乙女$$, who developed $$ゲッターロボ$$, but...」

474:t_019:6.en:
$$さやか$$
「Now they've been infected by $$インベーダー#robot$$s and completely assimilated with them.」

474:t_019:7.en:
$$ボス$$
「Those bastards...! I thought they were at the galactic center, but they came all the way to Earth!」

474:t_019:8.en:
$$隼人$$
「Have you come to watch your archenemy $$竜馬$$ die?」

474:t_019:9.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「It's a shame. As someone chosen by $$ゲッター線$$ like us, I thought he would become our comrade.」

474:t_019:10.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Indeed. A true shame.」

474:t_019:11.en:
$$隼人$$
「I won't let you have your way with $$竜馬$$.」

474:t_020:2.en:
$$弁慶$$
「You mean you'll finish $$竜馬$$ off?!」

474:t_021:0.en:
$$號$$
(Photon Power and $$ゲッター線$$ are now becoming one...!)

474:t_021:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Wake up, $$流竜馬$$! Is this all the man you are?!」

474:t_021:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「He snapped him out of it with a Big Bang Punch?!」

474:t_021:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「This is insane! It's beyond comprehension!」

474:t_021:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「It's the reverse of what usually happens.」

474:t_021:6.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Come to think of it, $$竜馬$$ once gave us a pretty hard punch too.」

474:t_021:9.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「What a pointless thing to do.」

474:t_021:10.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「No matter. Then we'll deliver the final blow.」

474:t_022:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「...You're too loud, $$甲児$$. Don't shout right when I wake up.」

474:t_024:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You guys went too far. $$ブラックゲッター$$'s almost scrap!」

474:t_025:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「That's because a certain idiot wouldn't wake up.」

474:t_025:3.en:
$$隼人$$
「Hurry up, $$竜馬$$. The $$インベーダー#robot$$s are waiting for you.」

474:t_026:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$ゲッターロボ$$ really is at its best with three pilots aboard!」

474:t_026:1.en:
$$凱$$
「What?! $$真ゲッター$$'s power is increasing!」

474:t_026:2.en:
$$號$$
($$竜馬$$... Through Photon Power, have you learned how to bring your own will into harmony with $$ゲッター線$$?)

474:t_026:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Come on, $$號$$! Let's give him a taste of how terrifying $$ゲッター$$ can be!」

474:t_027:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「It's too late to run now!」

474:t_027:2.en:
$$隼人$$
「We'll fight you your own way.」

474:t_027:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Get ready! This is the power of $$ゲッター$$!!」

474:t_028:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Looking good, you guys! You're fired up like nothing else!」

474:t_028:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't underestimate us. This is business as usual for us.」

474:t_029:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That punch of yours hit home, $$甲児$$.」

474:t_029:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You've got quite a mouth on you.」

474:t_029:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「To celebrate your recovery, I'll back you up! Go wild to your heart's content!」

474:t_030:1.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「How fearsome $$ゲッターロボ$$ is! How fearsome $$流竜馬$$ is!」

474:t_030:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$コーウェン$$! $$スティンガー$$! I'm human!」

474:t_030:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Sure, just like you said, I used to be like a stray dog. Everyone who came near me was an enemy...」

474:t_030:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But I've changed! Because I met my friends and $$ゲッターロボ$$!」
